description: Dark-fleet signals from Global Fishing Watch: AIS gap events (a vessel switching its transponder off, with off/on positions, gap hours and distance) or at-sea encounters between two vessels (possible ship-to-ship transfers, with both vessels, duration and median distance), filtered by flag and vessel type over the last 1 to 30 days, newest first. Coverage is GFW's (mostly fishing, carrier, bunker and support vessels). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

flag.description: Vessel flag as ISO-3 code, e.g. RUS, PAN, CHN (optional)

kind.description: gaps (AIS off, default) or encounters (vessel meetings at sea)

vesselType.description: fishing, carrier, bunker, support, cargo, tanker, passenger, other, gear (optional)

name: logistics_dark_fleet_ais_gap
title: Logistics Dark Fleet Ais Gap
